english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the human hand.
Use this for the humorous or mildly contemptuous human-hand sense, as in telling someone to take their dirty hands off something.

examples.english: I got my hand caught in the door.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 bei2 mun4 gaap3 can1 laa3

examples.english: Keep your paw off my stuff.
examples.jyutping: nei5 zek3 sau2 m4 hou2 dim3 ngo5 di1 je5
